contract.question: Which decision changes does TRACE distinguish?
contract.claim: Workload, released-label allocation, and review service answer separate evaluation questions for the same detector outputs.
contract.basis: The fixed TRACE comparator definitions and unchanged external rosters; this is a workflow diagram without simulated quantitative values.
contract.exclusions: Training counts, source-boundary audit logs and seals are reported in Methods/SI rather than occupying the main conceptual diagram.

visual_review.scope: Original-resolution image and final physical-size geometry/glyph/alignment/strict-collision gates
visual_review.inspection: The complete diagram and all three branches were visually inspected. Text stays within its intended boxes, arrows and reading order are clear, and no illustrative numerical outcomes are drawn.
visual_review.public_copy_reexport: Final PNG bytes are identical to the original-resolution image actually inspected; the new PDF passed all geometry/glyph/alignment/strict-collision gates again.

contract.question: How does finite analyst capacity change completion and policy ranking?
contract.claim: Required review can exceed available capacity, while capped cost-versus-confidence rankings differ between collections.

panels.a: Boundary: fraction of fine-tuned CodeBERT project rosters completed by the original mandatory-review weighted policy across all predefined capacities.
panels.b: Decision comparison: full-roster paired source-cost-minus-confidence cost differences and precomputed project intervals at the same hard capacities.

contract.unit: project after averaging three actual fine-tuned CodeBERT fits
contract.exclusions: Main plot uses the primary neural detector and primary price scenario; both complete collections and all seven capacities retained. Reference detectors and every other fixed price scenario remain in SI/public aggregates.

visual_review.scope: Original-resolution image and final physical-size geometry/glyph/alignment/strict-collision gates
visual_review.inspection: Both panels and the complete 160-mm figure were visually inspected. All seven fixed capacities, full project denominators, interval ribbons and the zero-cost reference remain visible.
visual_review.public_copy_reexport: Final PNG bytes are identical to the original-resolution image actually inspected; the new PDF passed all geometry/glyph/alignment/strict-collision gates again.

contract.question: Does delayed reviewed feedback change cost, and is enough history available to update?
contract.claim: Primary rolling source calibration gives heterogeneous cost changes alongside limited arrived-label history.

panels.a: Decision comparison: every project paired rolling-minus-static source-calibrated cost at the primary slots/delay setting, with paired median intervals.
panels.b: Support for adaptation: all project counts of actually arrived reviewed labels at the same setting, with project medians.
